# unifi_network_user_group (Resource)

A UniFi user group — a bandwidth/QoS group (legacy `/rest/usergroup`) that caps the up/down rate of the clients assigned to it. The controller ships a protected default group.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Group name.

### Optional

- `qos_rate_max_down` (Number) Maximum download rate in **kbps**. Omit (or set to a non-positive value, the controller's unlimited sentinel) for no limit.
- `qos_rate_max_up` (Number) Maximum upload rate in **kbps**. Omit (or set to a non-positive value, the controller's unlimited sentinel) for no limit.

### Read-Only

- `attr_no_delete` (Boolean) Whether the controller protects this group from deletion (the built-in default group). When `true`, `terraform destroy` removes the resource from state without deleting the group on the controller.
- `id` (String) Controller object ID (`_id`). Import key.
